# Support

OnlyVulns is a nonprofit, public-interest project. Support is provided on a best-effort basis.

## Security Issues

Do not report security-sensitive issues publicly.

See `SECURITY.md`.

## General Questions

Use GitHub issues or discussions if enabled.

## Not Provided

OnlyVulns does not provide emergency incident response, legal advice, authorization to test third-party systems, or guaranteed remediation timelines.
